question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
WITH top_5_actors AS (
    SELECT actor_id
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
films_with_top_5 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT film_id
    FROM film_actor
    WHERE actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top_5_actors)
),
customers_who_rented AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    WHERE i.film_id IN (SELECT film_id FROM films_with_top_5)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers_who_rented) as customers_with_top_5_films,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) as total_customers,
    ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers_who_rented)::numeric * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer), 2) as percentage
